where: The Drownlight's lantern room — the Shutterkeeper beside the banked, shuttered lamp
mood: The Keeper's Hymn in pieces — a solo cello remembering the tune phrase by phrase over a held organ drone, one high bell like the thread of light at the shutters' seam.
_note: Lane N2, Drownlight family rung 3 (the darkest): the hymn in fragments on solo cello over a continuous organ drone; half-time feel on the 76 grid. Kept CONTINUOUS (a held drone under every bar) so it never reads as dead air. Never name the tune or mention the reference in a brief.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time with a slow half-time feel
a solo cello playing the hymn in long held fragments
a soft pipe organ holding a continuous low drone under every bar
a single high glass bell now and then, like a thin seam of light
a slow clockwork tick once a bar
solemn, elegiac, grieving, quiet and close
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the cello's hymn returns over the drone, the last bar lifting back to the first fragment}
